name: Michigan Boat Launch Finder source-integrity benchmark

baseline.note: The previous implementation began with 42 hand-authored launch records and tried to reconcile them to public data. That architecture allowed nonexistent or incorrectly named launches to remain visible.

fatalFailures: static or hand-authored launch inventory is treated as the map source
fuzzy name matching can create or preserve a launch
manual coordinates can become a routing destination
reference-only or flagged DNR records are displayed
the source can fail and legacy pins still appear
map pin and launch card do not share the same facility identifier
